caption: The drawing depicts a female figure standing and facing forward. She is wearing a large, full, white dress with vertical pink lines and small green accents forming a decorative pattern across the fabric. The dress features ruffled cuffs on the sleeves, a ruffled collar, and buttons running down the front. Underneath the dress, she wears light brown patterned bloomers that reach just above her ankles. On her feet are pointed-toe shoes colored green. The woman's hands and face are brown, and her cheeks are highlighted with a rosy red color. Her black hair is styled in two loose curls on either side of her face, and she wears a large, deep red hat with volume and folds. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a small, lightly sketched detail of lace or a collar, but it is not colored in. The background is plain and off-white. At the bottom right of the main figure, the name "Mary Humes" is written.
title: Doll
